scenarios.name: Transfer a custom command by double-clicking list rows

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon customization dialog has an empty Part Tools custom panel
"2D Sketches" is available in the source list
the user double-clicks "2D Sketches" in the source list
"2D Sketches" moves to the custom panel list
the target indicates a pending change
the user double-clicks "2D Sketches" in the custom panel list
the custom panel list is empty
"2D Sketches" is available in the source list again
the target still indicates a pending change
no User Commands panel appears on the Tools ribbon
